subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should `reload.accountScopedRestart` become the supported channel-plugin lifecycle contract, with Mattermost accepted as the first isolated opt-in?
rationale: This is an additive plugin contract that controls live delivery and recovery behavior; code review can validate implementation mechanics, but only the responsible owners can accept the long-term isolation guarantee and lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Accept after exact-head refresh
options.body: Approve the capability and Mattermost opt-in after rebasing onto current main and confirming the focused reload and type checks on that exact head.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the PR open and request a more constrained internal capability or additional contract documentation before exposing an opt-in usable by other plugins.

options.title: Retain wholesale reloads
options.body: Decline the new lifecycle contract and close the PR, accepting the existing multi-account disconnect churn.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the capability and Mattermost opt-in after rebasing onto current main and confirming the focused reload and type checks on that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The current suppression and restart lifecycle history makes this person the strongest available owner for accepting the new invariant.
